newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.10 up at 40.85 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday as the U.S. currency gained abroad, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open unchanged on Tuesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.20 percent compared to the opening at 2.50 percent.
